last_episode_to_air.overview: Amid the chaos beyond the world, MK encounters the goddess Nüwa and uncovers a secret so devastating it could alter everything.

name: LEGO Monkie Kid
overview: Centuries ago, the beloved Chinese Monkey King used his magical staff to capture and trap the evil Demon Bull King deep inside a mountain. Flash-forward to modern-day China, when fate leads MK (aka Monkie Kid), a young noodle shop delivery boy, to find the long-lost staff. Soon, MK and his best friends find themselves entangled in adventures packed full of action, mystery, imagination and magic.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A young boy named "MK", ​​who is obsessed with the old legends, discovers Monkey King's staff that was left on top of a hill to imprison the Demon Bull King. After DBK is released, MK must go on a journey of self-discovery to become the hero of this generation needs. Through trial and tribulation, MK will discover new powers, responsibilities and ways of defeating the villains in this futuristic world.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The Spider Queen teams up with a mysterious, shadowy villain to collect powerful artifacts in order to defeat MK and his legendary teacher Monkey King. And the mysterious benefactor, who will be revealed as Lady Bone Demon will emerge from the shadows with a plan to collect mystical items throughout the city in order to construct a device capable of defeating MK once and for all.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The Monkey King leads MK and the heroes on a Journey to the West to search for The Samadhi Fire, a weapon powerful enough to defeat the Lady Bone Demon. Ancient secrets are revealed and the team is pushed to breaking point as they realize that The Samadhi Fire may be as dangerous as the Bone Demon herself! To save the world, the heroes must work together and embrace their destiny!

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: For someone who tries to avoid world-ending calamities, MK the Monkie Kid certainly has to deal with a fair few of them...!

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: An unknown enemy has lured MK and his friends into a trap, and unbeknownst to them, they are falling into his plan, step by step. But when the heroes finally learn of a way to save the world, they set out to find the mysterious five colored stones, hoping that their power can repair the Pillar of Heaven!
